primer: GNA Axles makes forged rear axle shafts (~74%), spindles (~17%), and drive shafts (~9%) in Punjab for trucks, tractors, and SUVs (~53% domestic, ~47% export). H1 FY27 sales jumped +43% YoY to Rs 991.59 Cr on 0.19x D/E and zero dilution since 2016. Still, 151 debtor days, 14.3% ROCE, ~80% top-10 buyer share, a 9.96 pp promoter trim, and 5 distribution days in 25 sessions (-12.11% 28d RS) keep quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL. GNA is NOT_HELD in Zerodha, and at Rs 580.90 (0.99:1 R:R to Rs 673.00 Base Target at 16.5x FY28E EPS), we rate it WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3). Bid only in Rs 549.15–Rs 560.00 against a Rs 487.49 stop for 1.56:1–2.01:1 asymmetry.
